prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Reedmarsh: golden reeds, mirror pools, a stilt village and low woods in a warm mist. A buoyant reed-flute melody with light pizzicato strings. Acoustic strings, soft flute, gentle hand percussion, memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 1 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
